title: Directed asset relationship records and validation
description: First-class relationship records with type, direction, confidence, validation
spec:
1. Add API for creating/reading/updating/deleting asset_relationships.
2. Support all required relationship types (runs_on, hosts, depends_on, provides_service, connects_to, stores_on, backs_up_to, part_of, owned_by).
3. Store direction, confidence, notes, and timestamps.
4. Prevent duplicate relationships.
5. Prevent nonsensical relationships (e.g. storage pool running on a VM) unless explicitly marked special.
6. Audit every relationship write.
7. Verify validation rules via API tests.
